'''Trailblaze''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots that makes the wearer faster on paths, gravel and mud bricks. Its internal name is ''Traversal''.

== Obtaining ==
* [[Prayer of St. Clement]], a crafted [[blessing]] (Trailblaze III). In 1.12.2 it stores the old <code>main:traversal</code>, which turns into Trailblaze one level per tick while the boots are worn. The levels are added to any Trailblaze the boots already have, so the prayer raises sturdy leather boots to Trailblaze IV, and boots with Trailblaze III from the Prayer of Exodus to Trailblaze VI.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_traversal.json}}</ref>
* The Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]], traded from the [[Mouthpiece]] for [[The Tanakh]] (Trailblaze III, with Loyalty III and Power II).
* [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Trailblaze I, and those found in chests have it too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_boots.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
=== Speed ===
While the wearer walks on a path block, their movement speed increases by 0.0155 per level (added to the base player speed of 0.1), so Trailblaze III makes them about 46% faster. The bonus stays while they jump off the path and ends once they land on another block. It does not apply while riding or flying.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>

The path blocks are the pack's <code>#matcha:is_path</code> tag:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/is_path.json}}</ref>
* {{MCW|Dirt Path|dirt path}} and {{MCW|Coarse Dirt|coarse dirt}}
* {{MCW|Gravel|gravel}}
* {{MCW|Packed Mud|packed mud}}
* {{MCW|Mud Bricks|mud bricks}}, mud brick slabs and mud brick stairs
* [[Dirt Slab]]s

=== Durability and particles ===
Each time the wearer moves while on the ground on a path block, the boots have a 4% chance per level to lose 1 durability. Walking on a path block kicks up dirt particles every 5 ticks.

Trailblaze's anvil cost multiplier is 0.

== Issues ==
The developer's notes record that the speed boost from mud brick slabs applies after a jump but not when running normally.<ref>{{Cite changelog|quote=When running on mud brick slabs with traversal boots, when I jump I get the speed boost, but when I just run on it normally I don't get the speed boost}}</ref>
